description:
Long-running daemon. Counterpart to candidate_npm_promoter.py for github-discovered candidates. Every 300s, queries via WriteService /query: SELECT id, candidate_name, candidate_url, candidate_description FROM mcp_discovery_candidates WHERE (promoted IS FALSE OR promoted IS NULL) AND discovered_in_directory='github_topic' LIMIT 50. For each candidate: parse owner/repo from candidate_url (expected pattern https://github.com//; if pattern unmatched, mark candidate promoted=TRUE with metadata.skip_reason='url_unparseable' and continue). Mint server_id = hashlib.md5(('github|' + owner + '/' + repo).encode()).hexdigest()[:16]. Check existence via ws_query 'SELECT 1 FROM mcp_server_registry WHERE server_id = ?' (use server_id as a literal in SQL after validating it's hex-only); if exists, just mark candidate promoted=TRUE and skip the registry write. Otherwise GET https://api.github.com/repos// with 8s timeout, headers {Accept: 'application/vnd.github+json', X-GitHub-Api-Version: '2022-11-28', User-Agent: 'zo-sentinel/1.0'}; reads optional Authorization 'Bearer ' + os.environ.get('GITHUB_TOKEN'). Parse {full_name, description, html_url, homepage, stargazers_count, forks_count, open_issues_count, pushed_at, created_at, updated_at, default_branch, license.spdx_id (may be null), archived, disabled, owner.login, owner.type}. Build row for mcp_server_registry: {server_id, name=full_name[:255], registry_source='github', url=html_url, description=(description or '')[:1000], trust_score=0.0, verdict='unknown', verdict_reasoning='', confidence=0.0, last_assessed=null, first_seen=created_at or now, last_seen=now, last_scanned=now, scan_count=1, risk_tier='unassessed', metadata=json.dumps({stargazers_count, forks_count, open_issues_count, pushed_at, archived, disabled, license_spdx, owner_login, owner_type, days_since_push, observed_in_registries=['github']})}. ws_write the row; on success ws_execute UPDATE mcp_discovery_candidates SET promoted=TRUE, reviewed_at=now() WHERE id=?. On HTTP 404 (repo deleted or renamed), mark candidate promoted=TRUE with skip_reason='github_404' and continue. On 403 rate limit, back off until X-RateLimit-Reset + 30s. On other errors, log per-server error and continue (do NOT mark promoted -- will retry next cycle). Heartbeat thread every 30s. Single-instance lockfile at /home/workspace/logs/candidate_github_promoter.lock with stale-PID-reclaim semantics from candidate_promoter_daemon.py. Imports: requests, json, hashlib, datetime, threading, time, os, sys, pathlib, re only. NO duckdb, NO sqlite3, NO project imports. Polite inter-fetch sleep 1s authenticated, 6s unauthenticated. Logs structured INFO line per batch: 'batch done queried= promoted=

skipped= 404s= errors='. CRITICAL: hex-validate server_id before SQL interpolation (only [0-9a-f] permitted) to avoid injection.
